name: residual_notice_relations
methods: Keep the complete received archive and all 387 residual events in scope. Bind raw PDF, catalogue receipt, both text-reader inventories and existing primary field checks. The received archive is not certified complete public coverage.

Read all 41 candidate companion notices in full. Bind their explicit current price-adjustment effective dates, affected securities and relevant distribution period to the selected primary; preserve historical price changes, approval terms, ex-reference amounts, foreign currency and all conflicting passages separately.

Inspect every received title and full text for corrections, supplements, revisions, cancellation, deferral, changed entitlement and current implementation terms. Extend navigation to synonyms but do not use keyword absence as financial acceptance. Record explicit per-document and per-event findings, including unresolved or unrelated cases.

Review title-level financial amendments in full even without matching event dates; examine all flagged body contexts and retain the full source. Specific ambiguous financial layouts or amendment roles require original-page inspection.

Preserve each source catalogue date and the existing conservative known-at convention. Later publications may corroborate facts retrospectively but cannot be backdated into an earlier trading information set.

Keep all 1452 previously accepted records and 1530 source fields byte-equivalent at consolidation. Do not merge the eight out-of-scope listing proposals. Unresolved events remain explicit and cannot be cleared by absence of sources.
No changes to runtime source, active data, strategy, candidate budget, models, accounts or paper plan. Source acceptance and later registered integration have separate gates.
